defs.meaning: 盆；洗涤槽；流域；盆地，海盆；内港，内湾

examples.en: Water dripped into a basin at the back of the room.
examples.zh: 水滴入房间后面的一个盆里。

examples.en: We were given a basin of water to wash our hands in.
examples.zh: 我们得到了一盆水洗手。

examples.en: When he had finished washing he began to wipe the basin clean.
examples.zh: 他洗漱完后开始把水盆擦干净。

synonyms.meaning: 水池；[水文]流域；[地理]盆地；盆
